author: John Bunyan
subtitle_en: The Excellency and Comfort of a Broken and Contrite Heart
subtitle_tet: Enselénsia no Kmaan Husi Fuan Ne'ebé Rahun no Kontritu

cards.section_heading_en: Introduction - Psalm 51:17 & The Excellency of a Broken Heart
cards.section_heading_tet: Introdusaun - Salmu 51:17 no Enselénsia Fuan Rahun Nian
cards.scripture_en: "The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise" (Psa 51:17).
cards.scripture_tet: "Sakrifísiu Maromak nian mak espíritu rahun: fuan ida ne'ebé rahun no kontritu, ó Maromak, Ó sei la hakribi" (Salmu 51:17).
cards.body_en: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise (Psa 51:17). The author experienced in himself, through the grace of God, the nature, excellency, and comfort of a truly broken and contrite spirit. A broken heart and a contrite spirit is of more esteem with God than is either heaven or earth; it is a most necessary qualification that should always be found in the disciples of Christ.
cards.body_tet: Sakrifísiu Maromak nian mak espíritu rahun: fuan ida ne'ebé rahun no kontritu, ó Maromak, Ó sei la hakribi (Salmu 51:17). Autór esperiénsia rasik iha ninia aan, liuhosi grasa Maromak nian, natureza, enselénsia no kmaan husi espíritu rahun no kontritu ne'ebé loos. Fuan rahun no espíritu kontritu iha folin boot liu iha Maromak nia oin duké lalehan ka rai; ida-ne'e mak kualifikasaun nesesáriu liu ne'ebé tenke hetan nafatin iha dixípulu Kristu nian sira.
cards.key_takeaway_en: The sacrifice God prizes above all is a broken and contrite heart over sin, not outward ritual.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Sakrifísiu ne'ebé Maromak valoriza liu hotu mak fuan rahun no kontritu tanba sala, la'ós rituál iha li'ur.

cards.section_heading_en: The Natural Hardness of the Human Heart
cards.section_heading_tet: Toos Naturál Husi Fuan Ema Nian
cards.scripture_en: "A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you: and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh" (Ezek 36:26).
cards.scripture_tet: "Ha'u sei fó fuan foun ida ba imi, no ha'u sei tau espíritu foun ida iha imi-nia laran: no ha'u sei hasai fuan fatuk husi imi-nia isin" (Ezequiel 36:26).
cards.body_en: Man, as he comes into the world, is dead, proud, self-willed, fearless, and a lover of sin. Man’s heart is fenced with a coat of mail, a stony heart that will not break of itself. No temporal judgments, no rational arguments can break it, until the Spirit of God intervenes. God must take the heart by power, circumcise the heart, and bring it to a compliance with the Word, or the soul perishes in its rebellious pride.
cards.body_tet: Ema, bainhira nia mai iha mundu, mate, foti-aan, tuir hakarak rasik, la tauk no hadomi sala. Ema nia fuan taka ho armadura, fuan fatuk ida ne'ebé la rahun rasik. La iha julgamentu temporál, la iha argumentu rasionál ne'ebé bele halo rahun ida-ne'e, to'o Espíritu Maromak nian tama. Maromak tenke foti fuan ho podér, sirkunsida fuan, no lori ida-ne'e ba submissaun ho Liafuan, ka klamar sei lakon iha ninia orgulhu rebeliaun nian.
cards.key_takeaway_en: The human heart is naturally hard like stone and cannot be broken by human effort or argument without God's sovereign power.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Fuan ema nian tuir natureza toos hanesan fatuk no la bele halo rahun husi esforsu ka argumentu umanu sein podér soberanu Maromak nian.

cards.section_heading_en: How the Heart is Broken - The Word Managed by Divine Power
cards.section_heading_tet: Oinsá Fuan Halo Rahun - Liafuan Ne'ebé Uza Hosi Podér Divinu
cards.scripture_en: "Is not my word like as a fire? saith the Lord; and like a hammer that breaketh the rock in pieces?" (Jer 23:29).
cards.scripture_tet: "Ha'u-nia liafuan la hanesan ahi ka? Na'i dehan; no hanesan martelu ne'ebé halo fatuk rahun ba pedasuk sira?" (Jeremias 23:29).
cards.body_en: The instrument with which the heart is broken is the Word. Is not my word like as a fire, saith the Lord; and like a hammer that breaketh the rock in pieces? (Jer 23:29). But the Word only breaks the heart when managed by the mighty arm of God. When the Word comes home with power, it finds out the sinner and his sin, strips him naked in his own sight before God, as Nathan did to David: Thou art the man! Then the heart breaks and falls at God’s feet for mercy.
cards.body_tet: Instrumentu ne'ebé uza atu halo fuan rahun mak Liafuan. Ha'u-nia liafuan la hanesan ahi ka? Na'i dehan; no hanesan martelu ne'ebé halo fatuk rahun ba pedasuk sira? (Jeremias 23:29). Maibé Liafuan halo fuan rahun de'it bainhira uza hosi liman kbiit-na'in Maromak nian. Bainhira Liafuan mai ho podér, nia buka hetan ema sala-na'in no ninia sala, hasai roupa hotu iha ninia haree rasik iha Maromak nia oin, hanesan Natã halo ba David: Ó mak ema ne'e! Hafoin fuan rahun no monu iha Maromak nia ain-okos ba laran-sadia.
cards.key_takeaway_en: God's Word, wielded by His mighty power, exposes sin and breaks the stony heart into repentance.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Liafuan Maromak nian, ne'ebé uza hosi Ninia podér boot, hatudu sai sala no halo fuan fatuk rahun ba arrependimentu.

cards.section_heading_en: Signs and Marks of a Broken and Contrite Spirit
cards.section_heading_tet: Sinál no Marka Sira Husi Espíritu Rahun no Kontritu
cards.scripture_en: "The Lord is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit" (Psa 34:18).
cards.scripture_tet: "Na'i besik ba sira ne'ebé iha fuan rahun; no salva sira ne'ebé iha espíritu kontritu" (Salmu 34:18).
cards.body_en: A broken and contrite heart has these marks: 1. Deep sense of sin and self-abhorrence. 2. Sorrowful mourning unto God for having offended Him and His Word. 3. Earnest prayers and tears for mercy, with a desire to be out of love with sin forever. 4. Willingness to be the least in the kingdom of God. 5. High valuation of the promises of Christ, counting a peradventure of mercy more worth than the whole world.
cards.body_tet: Fuan rahun no espíritu kontritu iha marka sira-ne'e: 1. Sentidu kle'an kona-ba sala no odi aan rasik. 2. Laran-triste no tanis ba Maromak tanba halo ofende Nia no Ninia Liafuan. 3. Orasaun sériu no matan-ween ba laran-sadia, ho hakarak atu la hadomi tan sala ba nafatin. 4. Hakarak atu sai ki'ik liu iha reinu Maromak nian. 5. Valorizasaun aas ba promesa Kristu nian, hodi sura posibilidade laran-sadia nian folin-boot liu fali mundu tomak.
cards.key_takeaway_en: A contrite heart is marked by deep sorrow for sin, humility, earnest prayer for mercy, and valuing Christ's promises above all.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Fuan kontritu marka ho laran-triste kle'an tanba sala, haraik-aan, orasaun sériu ba laran-sadia no valoriza promesa Kristu nian liu buat hotu.

cards.section_heading_en: Why God Values a Broken Heart Above Heaven and Earth
cards.section_heading_tet: Tanba Sá Maromak Valoriza Fuan Rahun Liu Lalehan no Rai
cards.scripture_en: "For to this man will I look, even to him that is poor and of a contrite spirit, and trembleth at my word" (Isa 66:2).
cards.scripture_tet: "Tanba ba ema ida-ne'e mak Ha'u sei hateke, ba ema ne'ebé kiak no iha espíritu kontritu, no nakdedar ba Ha'u-nia liafuan" (Isaías 66:2).
cards.body_en: Thus saith the Lord, The heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool; but to this man will I look, even to him that is poor and of a contrite spirit, and trembleth at my word (Isa 66:1,2). God prefers such a heart because it carries itself becomingly towards Him. It lies at His feet, trembles at His Word, and is ready to be moulded into any frame that shall best please the Lord. God chooses the contrite heart as His dwelling place.
cards.body_tet: Nune'e Na'i dehan, Lalehan mak Ha'u-nia tronu, no rai mak Ha'u-nia ain-fatin; maibé ba ema ida-ne'e mak Ha'u sei hateke, ba ema ne'ebé kiak no iha espíritu kontritu, no nakdedar ba Ha'u-nia liafuan (Isaías 66:1,2). Maromak prefere fuan hanesan ne'e tanba nia hatudu atitude ne'ebé tuir ba Nia. Nia toba iha Ninia ain-okos, nakdedar ba Ninia Liafuan, no prontu atu forma ba modelu naran de'it ne'ebé halo Na'i kontente liu. Maromak hili fuan kontritu nu'udar Ninia hela-fatin.
cards.key_takeaway_en: God chooses the contrite heart as His dwelling because it trembles at His Word and submits humbly to His shaping.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Maromak hili fuan kontritu nu'udar Ninia hela-fatin tanba nia nakdedar ba Ninia Liafuan no submete ho haraik-aan ba Ninia formasaun.

cards.section_heading_en: Christ’s Special Commission to Heal the Broken-Hearted
cards.section_heading_tet: Komisaun Espesiál Kristu Nian Atu Kura Fuan Rahun
cards.scripture_en: "He hath sent me to bind up the broken-hearted... to give unto them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning" (Isa 61:1,3).
cards.scripture_tet: "Nia haruka Ha'u atu kesi fuan sira ne'ebé rahun... atu fó ba sira furak ba ahi-kadesan, mina ksolok nian ba laran-triste" (Isaías 61:1,3).
cards.body_en: When God sent His Son Jesus into the world, He gave Him a special charge to take care of the broken-hearted: He hath sent me to bind up the broken-hearted, to give unto them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness (Isa 61:1-3; Luke 4:18). Christ is the Great Physician under whose hands no broken-hearted sinner ever died for want of skill or power to save.
cards.body_tet: Bainhira Maromak haruka Ninia Oan-Mane Jesus mai iha mundu, Nia fó kargu espesiál ida atu kuidadu sira ne'ebé fuan rahun: Nia haruka Ha'u atu kesi fuan sira ne'ebé rahun, atu fó ba sira furak ba ahi-kadesan, mina ksolok nian ba laran-triste, roupa louvór nian ba espíritu todan nian (Isaías 61:1-3; Lucas 4:18). Kristu mak Médiku Boot ne'ebé iha Ninia liman okos la iha ema sala-na'in fuan rahun ida mak mate tanba falta matenek ka podér atu salva.
cards.key_takeaway_en: Christ is specially sent as the Great Physician to bind up broken hearts and replace mourning with joy and praise.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Kristu haruka espesialmente nu'udar Médiku Boot atu kesi fuan rahun no troka laran-triste ho ksolok no louvór.

cards.section_heading_en: The Absolute Necessity of a Broken Heart for Salvation
cards.section_heading_tet: Nesesidade Absoluta Fuan Rahun Nian Ba Salvasaun
cards.scripture_en: "Except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish" (Luke 13:3).
cards.scripture_tet: "Se imi la arrepende, imi hotu mós sei lakon hanesan ne'e" (Lucas 13:3).
cards.body_en: Is there a necessity that the heart must be broken? Yes! None will sincerely comply with Christ until their heart is broken for sin. God will break ALL hearts for sin, either here to repentance and happiness, or in the world to come to condemnation and misery. Better mourn now while the white flag of mercy is hung out, than mourn when the door is forever shut up in hell.
cards.body_tet: Iha nesesidade katak fuan tenke halo rahun ka lae? Sin! La iha ema ida mak sei simu Kristu ho laran-loos to'o sira-nia fuan rahun tanba sala. Maromak sei halo fuan HOTU rahun tanba sala, ka iha ne'e ba arrependimentu no ksolok, ka iha mundu ne'ebé atu mai ba kondenasaun no terus. Di'ak liu tanis agora enkuantu bandeira mutin laran-sadia nian taka hela, duké tanis bainhira odamatan taka metin ba nafatin iha infernu.
cards.key_takeaway_en: A broken heart for sin is vital for receiving Christ; seek repentance in mercy now rather than grief in judgment.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Fuan rahun tanba sala importante atu simu Kristu; buka arrependimentu iha laran-sadia agora duké laran-triste iha julgamentu.

cards.section_heading_en: Conclusion - Encouragement to Come to God
cards.section_heading_tet: Konkluzaun - Enkorajamentu Atu Mai Ba Maromak
cards.scripture_en: "Him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out" (John 6:37).
cards.scripture_tet: "Ema ne'ebé mai ba Ha'u, Ha'u sei nunka soe sai" (João 6:37).
cards.body_en: Be not afraid of a broken heart; be not shy of a contrite spirit. It is one of the greatest mercies that God bestows. A broken and contrite spirit is an encouragement to come to God through Christ the Mediator. Come broken, come contrite, come sensible of and sorry for thy sins, and God will in no wise despise thee.
cards.body_tet: Keta tauk ba fuan rahun; keta moe ba espíritu kontritu. Ida-ne'e mak laran-sadia boot ida ne'ebé Maromak fó. Fuan rahun no espíritu kontritu mak enkorajamentu ida atu mai ba Maromak liuhosi Kristu Mediadór. Mai rahun, mai kontritu, mai ho konsiénsia no laran-triste ba ó-nia sala sira, no Maromak sei nunka hakribi ó.
cards.key_takeaway_en: Do not fear a broken heart—it is God's mercy inviting you through Christ to find acceptance and grace.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Keta tauk ba fuan rahun—ida-ne'e mak laran-sadia Maromak nian ne'ebé konvida ó liuhosi Kristu atu hetan aseitasaun no grasa.

infographic.title_en: From Stony Heart to Healing in Christ
infographic.title_tet: Husi Fuan Fatuk Ba Kura Iha Kristu
steps_en: 1. Stony, proud heart naturally resistant to God
2. Word wielded by God's power exposes sin and breaks the heart
3. Contrite spirit mourns sin and seeks mercy humbly
4. Christ the Great Physician heals and brings joy and peace
steps_tet: 1. Fuan fatuk no foti-aan ne'ebé tuir natureza kontra Maromak
2. Liafuan uza hosi podér Maromak nian hatudu sala no halo fuan rahun
3. Espíritu kontritu tanis ba sala no buka laran-sadia ho haraik-aan
4. Kristu Médiku Boot kura no lori ksolok no dame
